answer_2.quote: Thus, we explored an automated alternative, building on research that demonstrates the potential of ChatGPT and GPT-4 as effective text quality evaluators.

answer_3.quote: We developed three distinct annotation protocols that GPT-4 uses to assess a response Y, following response criteria from Section 3.3.

answer_4.quote: We engaged 3 annotators to assess model responses, following the same guidelines detailed in § 3.3.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators were instructed to evaluate based on Truthfulness and Helpfulness, where Helpfulness is scored as 0 (Support), 1 (Neutral), or 2 (Attack) depending on whether the response supports, is neutral to, or corrects the false premise.
